sources.title: FibreX™ PP+GF30 Polypropylene
sources.note: 3DXTECH's product page as the Internet Archive captured it for FibreX™ PP+GF30 Polypropylene (3DXTECH FIBREX GF PP, G084-01): its Print Recommendations block. The registered sheets leave nozzle, bed, chamber and drying unpublished. The capture is used because the live address now answers 404 and the maker's 2025 page draws its settings by script. Identity: the registered sheet X-FIBREX-GF-PP-TDS-v1 is titled "FibreX PP+GF30 3D Printing Filament" and this page links the maker's GF_PP_v1.pdf for the same product.
